title: Make one workday distraction-free.
subtitle: Workday focus boundary
rationale: Keep feeds closed and incidental device drift negligible across one real workday each week.

evidence.summary: Short periods away from social media can improve well-being and reduce repeated demands on focus.

indications: Three-hour protected periods are already routine.
Feed checking still bookends every work session.
One day of full output matters more than availability.
